In [[algebraic geometry]], the '''Hurwitz scheme''' <math>\mathcal{H}_{d, g}</math> is the [[scheme (mathematics)|scheme]] parametrizing pairs (<math>C, \pi: C \to \mathbf{P}^1</math>) where ''C'' is a smooth [[algebraic curve|curve]] of [[genus of an algebraic curve|genus]] ''g'' and {{pi}} has degree ''d''.<ref>[[Joe Harris (mathematician)|Joe Harris]] and Ian Morrison. ''Moduli of curves.''
</ref>
